scope: Illustrative evidence extraction from Evans et al. 2013, not an exhaustive literature review or atmospheric retrieval.

claims.text: Hubble/STIS secondary-eclipse measurements give geometric albedo 0.40 +/- 0.12 at 290-450 nm and an upper bound of 0.12 at 450-570 nm at 1-sigma. These are broad wavelength constraints, not an RGB photograph.

The published best-fit reflectance suggests a deep-blue visible appearance. Reflective dayside clouds and absorption at longer wavelengths are an interpretation; exact cloud structures are unresolved.

Illustrate a deep-blue gas-giant atmosphere with subdued, soft cloud texture, gentle limb haze, and physically consistent spherical shading. Any mottling or broad flow-like texture is illustrative and must not be presented as measured storms. No solid surface, oceans, continents, rings, or moons. Use a black background and a planet-exposed camera. Render detailed light scattering and shading without implying resolved geographic detail.
